title: A notion of semi-cubical tribe
summary: The important notions our ideas revolve around are that of tribes, a class of categories aiming at modeling intensional type theory, and that of semi-cubical objects, for a category of cubes with symmetries and reversals. We introduce a general notion of $J$-tribes, tribes suitably enriched in presheaves over $J$, and $J$-frames in a tribe $\mathcal{T}$ as a category of $J$-shaped resolutions in $\mathcal{T}$, for a direct category $J$, and we construct the $J$-tribe of $J$-frames in $\mathcal{T}$.
